_comment: Rename to config.json to activate (vendored mode only — the referenced action takes these as inputs instead). `preview` builds & serves the pushed code in CI so screenshots match the commit exactly (no deployed URL needed); omit it to screenshot the deployed homepage. `routes` hints Gemini toward real pages worth screenshotting. `includeCommitLink` appends the commit URL to the post (default false). `flows` are optional owner-scripted product flows — see `_flows_comment`.

preview.command: npm ci && npm run build && npx serve -l 4173 dist

_flows_comment: Optional. When a merge's change is an interaction (capture:video) AND matches a flow (by `match.navTarget` substring of the detected component, or `match.paths` globs against the change's files), the poster records that whole flow instead of guessing one interaction: Gemini performs each natural-language step and the click-following camera zooms on every click and pans to the next. `url` is the start path; `payoff` is an optional final punch-in on the result. Remove this block if you don't use flows.

flows.name: score a post
steps: type a short, punchy sample X post into the draft field
